name: whybrary
description: A local-first personal why manager with a neuron-style graph and lightweight To-Do lists.

scripts.android:prepare: npm run android:init:ci && npm run android:wait && npm run android:mirror
scripts.android:dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 "npm run android:mirror; tauri android dev"
scripts.android:gradle:debug: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 "npm run build; npm run android:mirror; & 'src-tauri/gen/android/gradlew.bat' --project-dir 'src-tauri/gen/android' assembleDebug"
scripts.android:gradle:apk: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 "npm run build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run android:mirror; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'src-tauri/gen/android/gradlew.bat' --project-dir 'src-tauri/gen/android' assembleArm64Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run android:finalize:apk"
scripts.android:build:signed: npm run android:build:apk && npm run android:sign:apk
scripts.android:run: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 "npm run android:mirror; tauri android run"
